description: From the Trapnest Studio visual archive. Original work by THE LINE and the artists credited in this collection. We worked with MCX to create Mavrello Ballovic, and produce seven 3D animation episodes featuring this over-enthusiastic basketball with the small-man syndrome.

children: Visual archive / Original work and editorial by
We were asked by MCX & Dallas Mavericks to help create Mavrello Ballovic, and produce 7 episodes featuring this over-enthusiastic basketball with the small-man syndrome.

This is our first venture into 3D character animation. It's been a lot of fun!. We couldn't have done it without our amazing team of 3D artists and animators. You lot have been absolutely amazing! Couldn't have wished for a better team! And massive thanks to the MCX team, been an absolute dream to work with.
